identificationModule.briefTitle: Once-weekly Versus Twice-weekly Carfilzomib in Combination With Dexamethasone in Adults With Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase 3 Study in Subjects With Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma Receiving Carfilzomib in Combination With Dexamethasone, Comparing Once-weekly Versus Twice-weekly Carfilzomib Dosing

armGroups.label: Once-weekly Carfilzomib 20/70 mg/m² + Dexamethasone
armGroups.description:
Participants received carfilzomib administered by intravenous (IV) infusion on days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle (20 mg/m² on day 1 of cycle 1 and 70 mg/m² thereafter).

Participants also received 40 mg dexamethasone IV or orally on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 for the first 8 cycles; starting with cycle 9, dexamethasone was administered only on days 1, 8, and 15.

armGroups.label: Twice-weekly Carfilzomib 20/27 mg/m² + Dexamethasone
armGroups.description:
Participants received carfilzomib administered by IV infusion on days 1, 2, 8, 9, 15, and 16 of each 28-day cycle (20 mg/m² on days 1 and 2 of cycle 1 and 27 mg/m² thereafter).

Participants also received 40 mg dexamethasone IV or orally on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 for the first 8 cycles; starting with cycle 9, dexamethasone was administered only on days 1, 8, and 15.

interventions.name: Carfilzomib
interventions.description: Carfilzomib was administered as an IV infusion

interventions.name: Dexamethasone
interventions.description: Commercially available dexamethasone was obtained by the investigational site.
